philosophy.statement: A quiet Internationalist index in near-black and warm paper, with flat related surfaces and acid-green state signals.
philosophy.originality: Combine disciplined grids, multilingual sans-serif hierarchy, cinematic pacing, and semantic desktop windows into an original CIBA system. References are research inputs only; do not copy assets, text, raster chrome, code, or exact compositions.
principles: Use a rational asymmetric grid and whitespace as structure.
Limit interface color to black, warm paper, and one acid-green signal.
Use related near-black planes, quiet hairlines, and small state signals without hard shadows or visual window rotation.
Use one multilingual sans-serif family across headings, body, controls, and metadata, with locale-specific SC and JP forms.
Keep project content readable before, during, and after motion.

colorProvenance.explicitFeedback: Black and warm off-white plus one high-saturation vivid color; maximum three interface colors.
researchSources: Cooper Hewitt — A Harmony of Contrasts
Letterform Archive — Legacies of Swiss Style
colorProvenance.note: The palette is an active user-directed design decision, not a color extraction from any named reference.

surfaceTones.source: Derived from the unchanged night, warm-paper, and acid-green palette; no additional interface hue.

canonical.display: Noto Sans SC Variable, Noto Sans SC, sans-serif
canonical.editorial: Noto Sans SC Variable, Noto Sans SC, sans-serif
canonical.ui: Noto Sans SC Variable, Noto Sans SC, sans-serif
canonical.mono: Noto Sans SC Variable, Noto Sans SC, sans-serif

typography.figmaUiApproximation: Noto Sans SC; use Noto Sans JP for Japanese text
typography.ui: Noto Sans SC Variable for Chinese and English; Noto Sans JP Variable for Japanese

browserSCJP.zh: Noto Sans SC Variable, Noto Sans SC, sans-serif
browserSCJP.en: Noto Sans SC Variable, Noto Sans SC, sans-serif
browserSCJP.ja: Noto Sans JP Variable, Noto Sans JP, sans-serif

localeFonts.variableWeightNote: The browser uses self-hosted variable fonts with a continuous 100–900 weight range. Preserve existing font-size, font-weight, line-height, and letter-spacing values; the legacy mono role now uses the same sans-serif family.
localeFonts.legacyPlugin: The English concept plugin uses Noto Sans SC Regular and Bold and preserves its existing black-to-Bold alias so weights do not change. Regular, Bold, and Black are available in Figma; the browser family suffix Variable is not used as the Figma font-family name.

licenses.license: SIL Open Font License 1.1; the installed packages' complete license and copyright notices are preserved unchanged.

typography.brand: Small bold bilingual mark: 糍粑 CIBA
typography.display: Live semantic word groups. Latin display tracking starts between normal and -0.03em; Chinese and Japanese remain at 0. ESCAPE / PROJECT and UNIVERSITY / COURSEWORK use authored phrase breaks.
typography.windowTitle: 11–12px uppercase UI text with approximately 0.08em tracking
typography.metadata: 10–12px uppercase or tabular UI text in the same locale-specific sans-serif family; one compact verified record only

layout.background: flat near-black field, related 3% and 4% warm-paper mixed surfaces, and quiet warm-paper hairlines
layout.grid: disciplined asymmetric Internationalist grid; whitespace is structural
layout.hero: monumental CIBA title without redundant archive or edition labels, followed by one scroll-linked work stage with low-opacity draggable evidence images
layout.works: five large independent project windows arranged on a desktop window canvas
layout.coursework: three large bounded desktop sections containing fourteen smaller editable evidence windows

motion.principle: Controlled instability: motion signals state and editing rhythm, then settles.

entrance.notes: Use a restrained stagger; keep destination content legible.

worksDrag.feedback: raise the active window and update its transform immediately
worksDrag.authoredRotation: Stored rotation values remain unchanged in the authored positions; current CSS ignores visual rotation in both window and ordered modes.

motion.reducedMotion: Disable scatter entrances, authored rotation, per-letter rolling, and scroll scrubbing. Keep state changes instantaneous or crossfaded under 120ms.

accessibility.contrast: Use warm paper or acid green only on black; use black on acid green or warm paper. Never set acid green text on warm paper.
accessibility.focus: Visible 3px acid-green outline with 3px offset on title bars, controls, filters, dock buttons, and links.
accessibility.worksKeyboard: Focusable title bar; Arrow moves 16px, Shift + Arrow moves 48px, Escape minimizes, and dock buttons restore and focus.
accessibility.semanticFallback: Every project remains reachable through a normal anchor URL; mobile and ordered mode preserve document order.
accessibility.motionText: Hide duplicate motion glyphs from assistive technology and retain one readable heading label.
accessibility.media: Preserve meaningful alt text from the website JSON source.
accessibility.announcements: Filters and minimize/restore changes use a polite live region.

worksWindowSystem.scatter: Desktop default: absolute authored positions and intentional overlap without visual rotation; bring-to-front, minimize/restore, filters, and reset remain unchanged.
worksWindowSystem.ordered: Ordered responsive grid with transforms and rotations cleared; all visible summaries remain readable.
worksWindowSystem.mobile: Single-column semantic cards in source order; precision dragging and drag controls are removed.

windowStyle.background: surfaceTones.surface: 3% warm paper mixed into night; title bar and body share the same flat plane
windowStyle.border: 1px warm-paper rule at 26% opacity; active window uses a 1px acid-green rule at 60% opacity
windowStyle.internalRule: 1px warm-paper rule at 14% opacity; repeated control dividers are visually quiet
windowStyle.state: Warm-paper controls at rest; acid-green text, fine rules, and a small active-window mark signal interaction without a filled green title bar
windowStyle.shadow: none in all layouts and states
windowStyle.visualRotation: none; keep stored positions.rotation values unchanged for data parity

worksWindowSystem.editableHandoff: The plugin generates five independent overlapping Figma frames. Text, title bars, media placeholders, and OPEN labels remain editable; move whole frames to explore alternate compositions.

courseworkDesktopSystem.snapshotContract: Each Figma item mirrors the canonical code, English caption, media type, public source path, x/y/w position, and z-order; npm run check:design fails on drift.
courseworkDesktopSystem.outerWindow: One square-corner chapter region per section; transparent side borders retain geometry while thin top and bottom rules organize the surface. Its title bar shares the 3% warm-paper mixed near-black plane. Reset uses acid text on that plane, and the inner stage remains clipped.
courseworkDesktopSystem.innerWindow: Flat windows with 1px warm-paper boundaries at 22% opacity, 14% internal rules, and a 58% acid active outline. Title bar and body share the same surface with no hard shadow or visual rotation. Factual codes and captions use the shared sans-serif family; video windows retain their independent controls.

interaction.pointer: Title-bar drag only; active item rises and remains clamped to its section.
interaction.keyboard: Arrow 16px; Shift + Arrow 48px; Home resets one item; section RESET restores every authored position.
interaction.compact: Ordered, non-overlapping source sequence with drag handles removed.
interaction.video: Native controls remain independent from dragging in the website; Figma represents them as editable control markers.

courseworkDesktopSystem.originalityBoundary: Retain independent overlapping-window mechanics only. Exclude ZUTOMAYO purple/pink skin, pixel type, imagery, branding, buttons, code, and proportions.
